name: tamirs-superpowers
description: 29 bundled skills, smart worktree hooks, statusline, and MCP server stubs — plan, implement, review, debug, multi-agent setup, and audit code from one plugin.

interface.shortDescription: Plan, implement, review and ship code across five agent platforms
interface.longDescription: A portable agent toolkit: 29 skills, 10 role-based agents, worktree hooks and MCP stubs, shipped from one canonical source to every supported surface. Covers the full development lifecycle - decompose a request into a task graph, run each task under a role, integrate onto one branch, review the combined diff, and deliver a single pull request - plus repository scaffolding, standards audits, multi-agent setup, debugging and documentation review.
defaultPrompt: Plan this feature and break it into phases
Implement issue #42 and open a pull request
Drive this PR to merge - address the review comments and fix CI
Audit this repo against multi-agent standards
Scaffold a new repo for a CLI that tracks job applications
Turn this workflow into a reusable skill
